name: yggdrasil-mcp
description: Tree of Thoughts reasoning, deep planning, and plan management for Claude.
long_description:
Yggdrasil adds structured reasoning tools to Claude Desktop:

- sequential_thinking — step-by-step reasoning with revision and branching
- deep_planning — multi-phase planning sessions (init → clarify → explore → evaluate → finalize)
- list_plans / get_plan / promote_plan / archive_plans — plan lifecycle management

Fork of Anthropic's sequential-thinking server with critical bug fixes (string coercion, Claude Code #3084).

tools.name: sequential_thinking
tools.description: Step-by-step reasoning with revision and branching

tools.name: deep_planning
tools.description: Multi-phase planning sessions (init → clarify → explore → evaluate → finalize)

tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: List saved plans with keyword/status/source filters

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Retrieve a saved plan in markdown or JSONL

tools.name: promote_plan
tools.description: Promote a Claude Code orphan plan to the Yggdrasil index

tools.name: archive_plans
tools.description: Archive plans by age or session ID (dry-run by default)
